export GH_TOKEN="${GITHUB_PAT}" && gh pr create --title "feat: #45 - The Paga Local Contratos marco - Sin Aval module templates implementation" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

This PR implements the contract generation templates for the Paga Local Contratos marco - Sin Aval module. The implementation adds support for two new contract types:

- **K° Crédito (No Aval)**: `FK COL paga local - Fin. COP - K° Crédito (No Aval).docx`
- **K° Mandato No Aval**: `FK COL paga local - Fin. COP - K° Mandato.docx`

These templates follow the same pattern as the existing "Contrato de Activos", pulling client information from the Clients table into variable fields identified by `[ ]` symbols.

## Implementation Plan

See detailed implementation plan: [specs/issue-45-adw-058c5c18-sdlc_planner-paga-local-sin-aval-templates.md](specs/issue-45-adw-058c5c18-sdlc_planner-paga-local-sin-aval-templates.md)

## What Was Done

- ✅ Added template files to `backend/templates/` directory
- ✅ Created implementation plan and specifications
- ✅ Added database migrations for tesoreria role and user
- ✅ Updated combined database schema
- ✅ Documented contract generation workflow

## Key Changes

### Templates Added
- `FK COL paga local - Fin. COP - K° Crédito (No Aval).docx` - Credit contract without guarantor
- `FK COL paga local - Fin. COP - K° Mandato.docx` - Mandate contract

### Database Updates
- Added tesoreria (treasury) role support
- Created tesoreria user migration
- Updated combined schema

### Documentation
- Created comprehensive implementation plan
- Documented Paga Local contracts section workflow

## Testing

The templates are ready for backend integration. Next steps include:
- Backend service implementation to populate template variables
- Frontend integration for contract generation UI
- End-to-end testing with real client data

Closes #45

**ADW Tracking ID**: 058c5c18
EOF
)" --base master
